title: Biophysical evaluation of the oligomerization and conformational properties of the N-terminal domain of TDP-43.
authors: Herrera, Maria Georgina; Amundarain, Maria Julia; Santos, Javier
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TDP-43 N端结构域的低聚与构象特性，对象为RNA结合蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅涉及生物物理表征，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: TDP-43 is an RNA-binding protein that presents four domains comprising an N-terminal region, two RNA recognition motifs and a C-terminal region. The N-terminal domain (NTD) has a relevant role in the oligomerization and splicing activity of TDP-43. In this work, we have expressed, purified and biophysically characterized the region that includes residues 1 to 102 that contains the nuclear localization signal (residues 80-102, NLS). Furthermore, we have evaluated the oligomerization equilibrium for this protein fragment. Also, we have determined changes in the tertiary structure and its stability in a broad range of pH values by means of different spectroscopic methods. Additionally, we compared this fragment with the one that lacks the NLS employing experimental and computational methods. Finally, we evaluated the motion of dimeric forms to get insights into the conformational flexibility of this TDP-43 module in an oligomeric state. Our results suggest that this domain has a conformational plasticity in the vicinity of the single tryptophan of this domain (Trp68), which is enhanced by the presence of the nuclear localization signal. All these results help to understand the molecular features of the NTD of TDP-43.
abstract_zh: TDP-43是一种RNA结合蛋白，包含四个结构域：N端区域、两个RNA识别基序和一个C端区域。N端结构域（NTD）在TDP-43的寡聚化和剪接活性中发挥重要作用。在本研究中，我们表达、纯化并生物物理表征了包含核定位信号（残基80-102，NLS）的1至102残基区域。此外，我们评估了该蛋白片段的寡聚化平衡。同时，我们通过多种光谱方法测定了该片段在广泛pH值范围内的三级结构变化及其稳定性。另外，我们利用实验和计算方法将该片段与缺失NLS的片段进行了比较。最后，我们评估了二聚体形式的运动，以深入了解TDP-43这一模块在寡聚状态下的构象灵活性。我们的结果表明，该结构域在其单一色氨酸（Trp68）附近具有构象可塑性，而这种可塑性因核定位信号的存在而增强。所有这些结果有助于理解TDP-43 NTD的分子特征。
